title: The Recipe That Began with a Memory
youtube_title: The Recipe That Began with a Memory | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet attention can be warmer than advice.
summary: At a porch while rain ticks and nobody is late, Nana Ruth begins to tell Dori about a recipe that began with a memory, not a measurement. Dori wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
